Built UI calls a hard-coded API base (127.0.0.1:8000); any other launch port breaks the GUI
Tool audit log and JSON ledgers use unlocked read-modify-write; concurrent writers can lose events
Mac App Store distribution lane (sandbox, provisioning, App Review)
Native iOS client for the mobile interaction rows (F01-F20 are satisfied by responsive UI per assumption A5)

Phone access to a local Mucaro service (TLS LAN serving, an installable web app or a native client); the packaged app binds loopback only and the backend has no TLS, so iPhone-width evidence does not imply a mobile shipping channel
